stratum_generation.target_ply: base_rng.randint(min_target_ply, max_target_ply) exactly once per output index
stratum_generation.continuation: replay source opening through GameSession, obtain Core legal actions at each step, sort by canonical_json(action_to_dict(action)), select ordered[rng.randrange(len(ordered))]
reject_conditions: no legal action before target ply
stratum_generation.selection: first valid attempt in deterministic order

event_predicate.board_summary: total occupied squares and count by (owner,type_id)
event_predicate.inventory_summary: canonical count by (owner,type_id) from Position hand/inventory; empty mapping if absent
event_predicate.type_or_promotion_transformation: board population unchanged but (owner,type_id) count map changes
event_predicate.accepted_if: at least one A/B/C event occurs in source opening or continuation

families.alternating_sign: d_j = +1 for even j, -1 for odd j
families.seeded_normalized_pseudorandom: CPython random.Random(480703), uniform(-1.0,1.0) drawn in coordinate order

material_vector_and_directions.normalization: every nonzero raw direction divided by Euclidean L2 norm
material_vector_and_directions.candidate: P48-0_vector + sign * 0.10 * ||P48-0_vector||2 * normalized_direction for sign in [-1,+1]
material_vector_and_directions.validity: reject nonfinite/nonpositive non-anchor coordinates, apply one common scale to restore P48-0 reference_median, call existing checkpoint validity checks, reject rather than clip
material_vector_and_directions.deduplication: deduplicate identical resulting checkpoint IDs, retain first named direction/sign in frozen order, record aliases, do not refill

leverage.channel_rule: multiply each non-anchor board channel and corresponding existing hand channel by the same factor; do not invent absent hand channels; all other coordinates unchanged
leverage.flip_rate: number of positions whose best action differs from P48-0 baseline / total corpus positions
leverage.score_displacement: mean absolute perturbed_score - baseline_score in existing native score units
leverage.mean_flip_rate: arithmetic mean over unique usable perturbations; no position/type weighting or fitting
leverage.failure: construction failure is reported and excluded; any search failure invalidates the entire corpus/budget cell

search_contract.failed_search_policy: CELL_INVALID_SEARCH_FAILURE; retain failed positions in denominator

non_material_control.condition: only on a RuleSet/corpus with stable 40k-vs-80k teacher
non_material_control.candidate: baseline_field * factor; all other EvaluationConfig fields unchanged
non_material_control.signal: max family_mean_flip, where family_mean_flip is mean of valid 0.75/1.25 flip rates, >= 0.05
non_material_control.label: NON_MATERIAL_EXISTING_FEATURE_LEVERAGE

available_corpora.stable_definition: available corpus with valid zero-failure 40k-vs-80k agreement >= 0.85
available_corpora.unavailable_semantics: does not count as passing or failing leverage

per_corpus.non_material_signal: stable corpus and max existing family_mean_flip >= 0.05

cases.A: count(r: stable_teacher(r,F48_CONTROL) AND NOT single_type_signal(r,F48_CONTROL) AND learner_signal(r,F48_CONTROL)) >= 2
cases.B: count(r: max stable structural S49 learner-direction flip - control learner-direction flip >= 0.05) >= 2
cases.D: count(r: stable_any(r) AND NOT material_signal_any_stable(r) AND nonmaterial_signal_any_stable(r)) >= 2
cases.E: count(r: stable_any(r) AND NOT material_signal_any_stable(r) AND NOT nonmaterial_signal_any_stable(r)) >= 2
